# fzv v0.1.0

## 中文

本版本提供 Windows（`x86_64` / `aarch64`）上的 Zig 版本管理：`PATH` 里只需要一条 fzv 条目，切版本只改一个小文件，已经打开的程序下一次调用 `zig` 就是新版本。

### 新增

- 增加 `fzv get`、`use`、`ls`、`lls`、`rm`、`path`、`update`、`v`、`h` 命令。
- 增加 PowerShell 一行安装脚本：`irm https://github.com/ref42/fzv/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex`，下载对应架构的压缩包，按 `SHA256SUMS` 校验后解压到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\fzv` 并写入用户 `PATH`。
- 增加从 ziglang.org 索引安装：`dev`、`stable` 和精确版本，下载后按索引里的 SHA-256 校验再解压，一次可以给多个版本（`fzv get dev,stable`）。
- 增加镜像加速：并发探测 16 个社区镜像并按实测吞吐排序，大文件切成小块由多条连接下载，中断可以续传，镜像中途返回 `429` 时自动换下一个。
- 增加 `-j` 选项控制下载连接数（1–32，默认 8，`-j 1` 为单流）。
- 增加 `-path` 指定版本目录；切版本只写 `<版本目录>\.fzv\active`，已经打开的终端、IDE 和构建工具在下一次调用 `zig` 时使用新版本。
- 增加 `fzv update` 从 GitHub Releases 升级 fzv 自身，`-force` 不比较版本号直接重装。
- 增加 `-verbose`，打印镜像选择、校验值和解压路径。
- 增加 ZLS 共享安装，`zig` 和 `zls` 一起进 `PATH`。

## English

This release provides Zig version management for Windows (`x86_64` / `aarch64`): `PATH` needs one fzv entry, switching a version rewrites a single small file, and programs that are already open use the new version on their next `zig` invocation.

### Added

- Added the `get`, `use`, `ls`, `lls`, `rm`, `path`, `update`, `v` and `h` commands.
- Added a one-line PowerShell installer: `irm https://github.com/ref42/fzv/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex`, which downloads the archive for the machine's architecture, verifies it against `SHA256SUMS`, unpacks it into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\fzv` and adds it to the user `PATH`.
- Added installation from the ziglang.org index: `dev`, `stable` and exact versions, verified against the published SHA-256 before unpacking, with several versions in one call (`fzv get dev,stable`).
- Added mirror acceleration: 16 community mirrors are probed concurrently and ranked by measured throughput, large archives are split into chunks fetched over several connections, interrupted downloads resume, and a mirror that starts answering `429` is replaced.
- Added `-j` to set the download connection count (1-32, 8 by default, `-j 1` for a single stream).
- Added `-path` to choose the versions directory; switching a version writes only `<versions>\.fzv\active`, so terminals, editors and build tools that are already open use the new version on their next `zig` invocation.
- Added `fzv update` to upgrade fzv itself from its GitHub releases, with `-force` to reinstall without comparing versions.
- Added `-verbose` to print the mirror choice, checksums and unpacking paths.
- Added a shared ZLS install, with `zig` and `zls` both on `PATH`.
